analyzed_vuln.description: The root cause is constructing `subs` from `table + table->substitutionTables` in the contextual morx subtable driver without validating that the offset points to a complete `UnsizedOffsetListOf` header (and at least one offset entry). For non-extended (`ObsoleteTypes`) execution, `ContextualSubtable::sanitize()` returns early and does not sanitize `substitutionTables` at all, so a malformed font can provide an out-of-range/truncated substitutionTables offset. Later, `transition()` indexes `subs[...]`, causing `OffsetTo::operator()` to read a 2-byte offset past the font buffer (ASan crash in BEInt/HBUINT16 read).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Input must reach AAT morx contextual subtable processing in hb-shape-fuzzer with a malformed mort/morx table using ObsoleteTypes path (`Types::extended == false`), where `substitutionTables` offset is near/end-of-buffer or otherwise invalid/truncated. Data flow: fuzz input -> font blob -> hb_aat_layout_substitute() -> mortmorx::apply() -> ChainSubtable::apply()/dispatch() -> ContextualSubtable::apply() -> driver_context_t ctor initializes `subs` from unvalidated offset -> transition uses `subs[markIndex/currentIndex]` -> OOB 2-byte read.
